articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2022 and provided guidance for 2023. For the three months ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, the Company reported a Net Loss of $0.1 million, or $0.00 per diluted share, and a Net Loss of $10.8 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, respectively. For the twelve months ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, the Company reported Net Income of $52.2 million, or $0.77 per diluted share, and a Net Loss of $5.4 million, or $0.08 per diluted share, respectively.
